title: Freepod: deployments
description: Every deployment's resource use, side by side.

targets.expr: count(max by (namespace) (kube_namespace_labels{job="prometheus-kube-state-metrics",label_caelus_dev_tenant="true",label_caelus_dev_environment="$environment"}))

panels.title: CPU used

targets.expr: sum(sum by (namespace) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{container!="",container!="POD"}[5m])) * on (namespace) group_left () max by (namespace) (kube_namespace_labels{job="prometheus-kube-state-metrics",label_caelus_dev_tenant="true",label_caelus_dev_environment="$environment"}))

panels.description: Cores, every container of every deployment, sidecars included.

targets.expr: sum(sum by (namespace) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{container!="",container!="POD"}) * on (namespace) group_left () max by (namespace) (kube_namespace_labels{job="prometheus-kube-state-metrics",label_caelus_dev_tenant="true",label_caelus_dev_environment="$environment"}))

panels.title: Pod network

targets.expr: sum(sum by (namespace) (rate(container_network_receive_bytes_total[5m])) * on (namespace) group_left () max by (namespace) (kube_namespace_labels{job="prometheus-kube-state-metrics",label_caelus_dev_tenant="true",label_caelus_dev_environment="$environment"})) + sum(sum by (namespace) (rate(container_network_transmit_bytes_total[5m])) * on (namespace) group_left () max by (namespace) (kube_namespace_labels{job="prometheus-kube-state-metrics",label_caelus_dev_tenant="true",label_caelus_dev_environment="$environment"}))

panels.description: Received plus sent, all pod traffic: includes each app's own database and object storage traffic.

panels.title: HTTP requests

targets.expr:
sum(sum by (namespace) (
  label_replace(sum by (service) (rate(traefik_service_requests_total[5m])), "svc_key", "$1", "service", "(.+)-[^-]+@kubernetes")
  * on (svc_key) group_left (namespace)
  max by (svc_key, namespace) (label_join(kube_service_info{job="prometheus-kube-state-metrics"} * on (namespace) group_left () max by (namespace) (kube_namespace_labels{job="prometheus-kube-state-metrics",label_caelus_dev_tenant="true",label_caelus_dev_environment="$environment"}), "svc_key", "-", "namespace", "service"))
))

panels.description: Requests Traefik forwarded to a deployment's Service.

targets.expr:
sum(max by (namespace) (
  label_replace(kube_namespace_labels{job="prometheus-kube-state-metrics",label_caelus_dev_tenant="true",label_caelus_dev_environment="$environment"}, "deployment_hex", "$1$2$3$4$5", "label_caelus_dev_deployment_id", "([0-9a-f]{8})-([0-9a-f]{4})-([0-9a-f]{4})-([0-9a-f]{4})-([0-9a-f]{12})")
  * on (deployment_hex) group_left ()
  max by (deployment_hex) (max by (datname, deployment_hex) (label_replace(pg_database_size_bytes, "deployment_hex", "$1", "datname", ".*([0-9a-f]{32})")))
))

sum(max by (namespace) (
  label_replace(kube_namespace_labels{job="prometheus-kube-state-metrics",label_caelus_dev_tenant="true",label_caelus_dev_environment="$environment"}, "bucket", "dep-$1", "label_caelus_dev_deployment_id", "(.+)")
  * on (bucket) group_left ()
  max by (bucket) (caelus_bucket_bytes)
))

panels.title: PVC provisioned

targets.expr: sum(sum by (namespace) (kube_persistentvolumeclaim_resource_requests_storage_bytes{job="prometheus-kube-state-metrics"}) * on (namespace) group_left () max by (namespace) (kube_namespace_labels{job="prometheus-kube-state-metrics",label_caelus_dev_tenant="true",label_caelus_dev_environment="$environment"}))

panels.description: Requested size. Nominal: local-path enforces no quota, and kubelet reports no usage for its volumes.

panels.title: Deployments
panels.description: One row per deployment in the environment. Click a hostname for its detail dashboard. Rates are 5m averages as of the end of the time range; Restarts count across the whole range.

targets.expr:
group by (namespace, host) (topk by (namespace) (1,
    group by (namespace, host) (kube_ingress_path{job="prometheus-kube-state-metrics",host!~"preview-.+"}) * 2
  or
    group by (namespace, host) (kube_ingress_path{job="prometheus-kube-state-metrics",host=~"preview-.+"})
) * on (namespace) group_left () max by (namespace) (kube_namespace_labels{job="prometheus-kube-state-metrics",label_caelus_dev_tenant="true",label_caelus_dev_environment="$environment"}))
or on (namespace)
label_replace(max by (namespace) (kube_namespace_labels{job="prometheus-kube-state-metrics",label_caelus_dev_tenant="true",label_caelus_dev_environment="$environment"}), "host", "(no hostname)", "namespace", ".*")

max by (namespace, label_caelus_dev_deployment_id, label_caelus_dev_product, label_caelus_dev_owner_id) (kube_namespace_labels{job="prometheus-kube-state-metrics",label_caelus_dev_tenant="true",label_caelus_dev_environment="$environment"})
